modelElements.label: Model Elements (Ask the Model)
modelElements.description: Elements of an IFC model that match an 'Ask the Model' query; always the file's newest version. An eq filter is required for fileId (or versionId) and modelQuery (the query JSON). Properties with the 'p.' prefix (p.FireRating).
